_howTo: Deals people submitted with the site's 'Submit a deal' form (GitHub issues), after you approved them.
Don't edit by hand: approve a submission with `npm run approve-deal -- <issue number>`. It checks every field and adds it here.
To take a deal down, delete its entry and run `npm run scrape:local` (or just push). Deals also disappear on their own after their endDate.
Fields mirror the form; issue is the GitHub issue number it came from.
